name: @openav/out
description: Web-page parameters to physical hardware through one local bridge: WLED (DDP), serial motor boards, OSC — with a watchdog that falls back to safe values.

lab.autowire: lab.out = OutClient on ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out (this machine's out-bridge; ?out=sim records values only, ?out=ws://… another bridge, ?out=0 off): lab.out.set(ch, v) / batch({…}) once per frame per channel, .status / .onStatus, and meta.params[].out binds a param (normalized 0..1, or raw with outRaw) to a channel such as light/1/r.
